samples.manifestSummary: id com.lumen.samples.chartkit · kind code · capabilities [ui:slot, ui:command, i18n:contribute, lint:rule, ai:recipe, storage, deck:read, deck:write] · contributes slots/i18n/lintRules/recipes
samples.code:
function barSvg(rows) {
  const values = rows.map((r) => Number(r.at(-1))).filter(Number.isFinite)
  const max = Math.max(1, ...values), bw = 72, gap = 24, base = 400, plot = 320
  const bars = values.map((v, i) =>
    `<rect x="${120 + i * (bw + gap)}" y="${base - (v / max) * plot}" width="${bw}" ` +
    `height="${(v / max) * plot}" rx="4" fill="var(--d-accent)"/>`).join('')
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1360 420">${bars}</svg>`
}
lumen.ai.registerRecipe({ id: 'bar', namespace: 'chartkit', title: { zh: '数据柱状', en: 'Data bars' },
  build: (content, themeId) => [{ type: 'svg', x: 120, y: 350, w: 1360, h: 420,
    viewBox: [0, 0, 1360, 420], source: barSvg(content.points.map((p) => p.split('='))), animate: 'none' }] })
shouldDo: 配方 build 返回块对象数组（不是 DOM），几何落在安全边距内
只改 source/viewBox 的 updateBlock 回改；数据存插件 storage，deck 里不存 CSV 原文
颜色只用 var(--d-*) 令牌，卸载后 deck 里仍是普通 svg 块
shouldNotDo: 不硬编码十六进制颜色

samples.manifestSummary: id com.lumen.samples.focusdesk · kind code · capabilities [ui:slot, ui:command, ui:keymap, ui:layout, i18n:contribute, storage, deck:read] · contributes layoutPresets/keymap/slots/i18n
samples.code:
lumen.ui.onRender(async (root) => {
  const snap = await lumen.deck.getSnapshot() // 含 lint 摘要与每幕 textChars/readingSeconds
  lumen.ui.setTitle(lumen.i18n.t('dock.title'))
  const rows = snap.slides.map((slide, i) => lumen.ui.el('tr', { 'data-slide-id': slide.id },
    lumen.ui.el('td', { text: String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0') }),
    lumen.ui.el('td', { text: lumen.i18n.t('dock.words', { count: slide.textChars }) }),
    lumen.ui.el('td', { text: lumen.i18n.t('dock.readTime', { seconds: slide.readingSeconds }) })))
  root.append(lumen.ui.el('table', null, ...rows))
})
lumen.commands.register({ id: 'layout-focus', title: { zh: '专注布局', en: 'Focus layout' },
  run: () => lumen.layout.apply('focus') })
shouldDo: 最小权限：manifest 无 deck:write / theme:contribute / asset:write / export:hook
字数与秒数直接用 snapshot.slides[].textChars / readingSeconds（不复制阅读速度常量）
布局预设只走 contributes.layoutPresets；跳幕只调 view.gotoSlide 白名单命令
shouldNotDo: 不写 deck（任何自动改字都拒绝）
